findings.claim: Q3 2026: Electrical Solutions sales +51% to ~$845M (organic +22%, acquisitions ~29pts); data-center sales up >80% organically. FY2026 Electrical Solutions organic growth guided 17-18%.

Q3 2026: Utility Solutions sales +9% to $1,028M (organic ~5%); Grid Infrastructure ~+13%, Grid Automation ~-4%; ~$15M meter-component shortage shifted revenue to Q4. FY2026 Utility organic guide 6-7% (cut from 7-9% per one analysis).
findings.source: Hubbell 8-K Q3 2026 earnings release; MarketBeat Q3 call highlights

findings.claim: Management expects data-center, electric T&D and renewable markets to remain strong in 2027; Utility backlog up >$500M YTD; heavy industrial markets relatively soft.
Q2 2026 call: recent price increases expected to add ~3-4% price realization for the year to offset input costs; no market share data found.
findings.source: Stock Taper HUBB Q2 2026 earnings call summary / Barchart
